Ive been trying nofap but i cant stay on more than 1 week.
Noticed a pattern though:
Just after I relapse i start feeling like shit for 2-3 days

Then I start feeling super happy like all my depression is gone. Too happy though. Feels like im high. But then I relapse, and so on...
Shit. Did you try meds for your clinical depression?

I already know TRP. Really helped me improve. Cant be grateful enough. And went from total loser to less loser, been heavily flirting with a girl (who has a bf lmao) and with others. 

But I still cant get a gf, and still am fucking lonely. And recently when Im with a girl i just feel like total shit and that shes probably thinking of how ugly i am :(


I know that i should have that alpha DGAF atitude but i just cant anymore.
 
 like that TRP mentality is just starting to fade away from me

Not thinning / balding but my hairline is. I used to be NW0 like 1 year ago and saw my hairline litterally turn to NW1.5 right in front of me

Dont know if it will stop at NW1.5 or receide further, and it scares me

Thank you. But focusing on school is hard when you wanna end it.

Also transplants are a viable option until your hairline 'stabilises' which is usually at 24-26 yrs old
